title: Test OAuth revoke by asserting token state for both token types, not just the sweep
answers: How should I test cross-client OAuth revoke behavior?
Why did the old other-client revoke test miss the bug?
body:
Revoke tests in posthog/api/oauth/test_views.py should assert the actual token rows are unchanged, not only the DCR session sweep side effect.
- `test_dcr_token_revoke_from_other_client_leaves_session_untouched` is parameterized over `refresh_token` and `access_token` presented, and asserts `OAuthRefreshToken.revoked` is None and the application's `OAuthAccessToken` set is intact.
- The earlier test only checked the sweep, so it passed while upstream django-oauth-toolkit still revoked the token.
- Cover both token types when changing `revoke_token` in posthog/api/oauth/views.py.
